name: opravdanie
source:
When visiting your parents at the cemetery, you certainly do not expect to run into an old classmate who used to have a crush on you. And especially not looking the way they do. What will this turn into – the beginning of a new relationship or a fatal mistake?

[Translated from [url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-3154]Anivisual[/url]]
translation:
当你去墓地探望父母时，你当然不会想到会遇到一个曾经暗恋过你的老同学。尤其是不像他们那样。这会变成什么——一段新关系的开始还是一个致命的错误？

[译自[url=https://anivisual.net/stuff/2-1-0-3154]Anivis[/url]]
